User Story

 

As a system user

I want to be able to cancel a real invoices in the system

So that I will have possibility not to charge customers for that invoices

 

Design: Invoices_cancellation (adobe.com)

 Process: https://app.diagrams.net/?src=about#G16ebHk1iNQZxJYYVvmuzgcTQQxSDKuSis

Acceptance criteria:

  1. Check system user permission for cancelling the invoices

    1. Permission - 'Cancel Invoices'

      1. Allows to cancel all the invoices in the system

  2. It is possible to cancel only the real invoices in the system manually or via Mass import functionality

    1. When a proforma invoice is cancelled (regardless of the cancellation path — from Service Order or from Billing > Invoice Cancellation), the system shall not create a Cancel Invoice document and shall not assign an invoice cancellation document number. The invoice status shall be changed to Cancelled.

  3. Cancelling the invoice means to change its status as Canceled and the record will be saved in the system. Already cancelled invoice number should not be used for another invoice record.

  4. Invoice cancellation is possible from the invoice menu by clicking on an Invoice Cancellation row

  1. Invoice cancellation object contains the following fields:

    1. List of invoices

      1. Text box

      2. Optional

        1. Mandatory if import file is not uploaded and user clicks on Save button

      3. Length: 1-2048 characters

      4. Display a scrollbar if selected items exceed 2 lines

      5. Allowed symbols: All symbols are allowed. Should not be only spaces. Spaces at the beginning and at the end should be trimmed

      6. It is possible to manually write a numbers of real invoices in this box and after clicking on a Save button of an object, those invoices will be cancelled

      7. User should write invoice numbers in text box divided  by commas

        1. For example: FP0005265895, FP0005265857

      8. System should trim the intervals and take invoice number between the commas for cancellation

      9. It is possible to delete already written invoice number from the text box before clicking on Save button

      10. Minimum number of the invoice numbers written in the text box should be 1

    2. Import functionality

      1. If  in the text box invoice number isn't written, then it is mandatory to upload a file for import

        1. Choose file button

          1. It is possible to upload a xlsx file from the compute for import

          2. File should contain a real invoices' numbers

          3. If file structure is correct, after clicking on Save button, system will automatically start invoice cancellation process

          4. If file structure is not correct, after clicking on Save button, system should display an error message

        2. Download template button

          1. It is possible to download an invoice cancellation template

          2. Invoice cancellation template includes rows:

            1. Invoice Number - mandatory column

            2. Creation Date - optional column. When Creation date is defined, it means that system should cancel invoice with this number which is created latest

      2. After clicking on a Save button, system will automatically start an invoice cancellation process and will display its results in the Processes page in the system settings module

      3. It is possible to upload only one file for each cancellation process

      4. Uploaded file name will be set in the text field

      5. Maximum amount of invoices in the file are not restricted

      6. Minimum amount of invoices for cancellation is 1

    3. Tax event date

      1. Mandatory

      2. Date picker

      3. Format: DD.MM.YYYY

      4. Data should be in between 01.01.1990 to 31.12.2090

      5. User may select any date that falls within an open accounting period (including past dates within an open period).

      6. In the UI, the date picker minimum and maximum are set to the start and end of the open accounting period(s).

      7. The system validates on save that the selected Tax event date belongs to an open accounting period; if not, the request is rejected and an error message is displayed.

      8. This is a date which should be included in the generated letters as a date in which the invoices were cancelled, however the cancellation process should be started immediately after clicking on Save button

    4. Accounting period — invoice cancellation

      1. NEW: Cancellation is allowed when the invoice's accounting period is closed

    5. Receivables at cancellation

      1. NEW: For invoices created from a billing run, receivables created during invoice cancellation are recorded in the accounting period that corresponds to the cancellation date (Tax event date), not the billing run's accounting period.

    6. Invoices without liability or receivable

      • When an invoice does not have a liability or receivable (which only occurs when the invoice amount is zero), invoice cancellation shall still be possible and the system shall change the invoice status to Cancelled.

    7. Sub-object:

      1. Invoice Template

        1. Mandatory to add at least one template

        2. Template is added manually by clicking on a Plus button

        3. When clicking on a Plus button modal window should be opened with fields:

          1. Template

            1. Mandatory

            2. Single select dropdown

            3. It is possible to select a template from the system

            4. Save button - when user finds a needed template and clicks on this button, modal window should be closed, and the template is added to the invoice cancellation page

            5. Cancel button - modal window is closed and user stays on invoice cancellation page

        4. Template will be used for each invoice which was cancelled during the process

        5. It is possible to add more than one template and in this case, all the letters should be generated for each invoice

          1. For example: there are 2 templates attached to the invoice cancellation process and user wants to cancel 10 invoices, system should generated 20 letters (2 for each invoice)

        6. After invoices are cancelled, generated document should be sent to the respective customers

        7. Maximum amount of the templated are not restricted

  2. Clicking on 'Save' button will check all the validations (frontend and backend)

    1. If all the validations are successful, the system should start invoice cancellation process immediately and display all the results in the Process's object

    2. If frontend validations are not successful, system should display an error message with proper field

    3. If an error happens in backend, system should display an error message retrieved from the backend

    4. If user tries to cancel already cancelled invoice, system should display an error message

    5. If user tries to cancel a locked invoice, system should display an error message.

    6. When a proforma invoice is cancelled, the system shall not create a Cancel Invoice document and shall not assign an invoice cancellation document number.

    7. When the invoice is paid and its related payment package is locked, the system shall still allow invoice cancellation; invoice cancellation must not be blocked solely because the payment package is locked.

    8. The system validates that the Tax event date is in an open accounting period; if validation fails, an error message is displayed.

  3. Clicking on 'Cancel' or 'X' button warning pop-up message comes out 'Are you sure you want to cancel invoice cancellation process?' Yes/No

    1. Yes - will close pop-up and user is returned to the previous page

    2. No - will close pop-up and user stays on the current page

    3. Warning message should be managed via system settings
